name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px outer ring in #005fcc with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This keeps the ring thick enough to see on all screens while staying compact for mobile touch targets. The trade-off is slightly more visual weight, but it ensures keyboard users never lose track of focus—critical for EXCAVA’s usability.

name: Reader
text: I flag the 4px outer ring with a 2px white inner ring as a potential issue on patterned backgrounds where it may not provide enough contrast. A better alternative could be a thicker, solid ring, such as a 3px or 4px solid ring, which would provide more visual clarity, especially on high-contrast patterned backgrounds. To settle the argument, we need to test these different ring styles on a variety of backgrounds and with different screen readers to determine which one provides the best focus indicators for all users.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 3px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px white inner ring (total 5px) for focus. It meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on all backgrounds while keeping the ring compact for mobile touch targets. The trade-off is a slightly thinner outer ring, but it guarantees visibility for keyboard users without relying on background patterns.
[dispatched 3 workers: worker-8001, worker-7497, worker-3328 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: A 3px solid ring risks failing on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the ring may blend into busy textures. A better alternative is a 4px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px white inner ring (total 6px), which meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on all backgrounds while keeping the ring compact for mobile touch targets. The real risk is visual disappearance on patterned backgrounds, which would break accessibility for keyboard users. Testing on actual patterned backgrounds would settle the argument.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 4px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px white inner ring (total 6px) for focus indicators. The result must deliver a visible, WCAG 2.1 AA-compliant focus ring across all backgrounds and devices, owned by the accessibility team.
